kpis.signal: Effort R&D massif post-COVID, reduction progressive vers cible ~$3.5Md FY27

kpis.description_en: FY25 R&D $3,132M (-$1,411M YoY). Phase 3 readouts respiratory, oncology (mRNA-4157), rare disease, infectious. Target: cut R&D ~$1Bn by 2027 vs 2024.

kpis.signal: Reduction commerciale alignee avec deflation revenus COVID

kpis.description_en: FY25 SG&A $1,018M (-$156M YoY). Commercial vaccine cost, marketing Spikevax/mNEXSPIKE/mRESVIA. Post-pandemic optimization.

kpis.description_en: Cash + cash equivalents + investments at 12/31/25: $8.1Bn (incl. $600M term loan drawdown). Runway to fund R&D pipeline despite operating losses.

kpis.signal: Erosion de la base COVID, transition vers franchise multi-produits

kpis.description_en: FY25 total revenue $1,944M: product sales $1,818M (COVID $1,810M + RSV $8M) + other $126M (grant + collaboration + licensing/royalties). FY22 peak $19.3Bn.

kpis_story.description_en: mRNA-4157 (V940): individualized melanoma cancer adjuvant vaccine + Keytruda. Phase 3 INTerpath ongoing, BLA target 2026. High-potential bet.

kpis_story.description_fr: mRNA-1647 : vaccin CMV (cytomegalovirus). Phase 3 CMVictory readout attendu 2025-2026. Pas de vaccin CMV existant, marché vierge.
kpis_story.description_en: mRNA-1647: CMV vaccine. Phase 3 CMVictory readout expected 2025-2026. No existing CMV vaccine, greenfield market.
